Wait for a CSS selector that exists on the page

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, java.util.Arrays.asList(JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"selector\":\"#content\",\"type\":\"wait\"}", PageAction.class)));
        System.out.println(result.actionResults().get(0).success());
        System.out.println(result.actionResults().get(0).actionType());
        System.out.println(result.actionResults().get(0).actionIndex());
    }
}
```
